result.limits: Boundary reads instrument exploration; global swap is not process attribution. Process faults/RSS and MLX allocator usage are complementary signals, not complete model residency. File-backed pages do not reconstruct Activity Monitor Cached Files or its pressure formula.

decode.rate_byte_basis: VM page-equivalent bytes, not measured disk I/O
decode.swap_attribution: system-wide; process faults are not swap-specific

prefill.rate_byte_basis: VM page-equivalent bytes, not measured disk I/O
prefill.swap_attribution: system-wide; process faults are not swap-specific
